pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.preferencia_banco_ayuda: When you need to pay, TI will open this option without asking again.

Choose how you usually access your bank.

pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.cambiar_preferencia: You can change your bank access preference here (App or Web).
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.url_app_auto: When you pay, TI will open {banco}'s {canal} based on your preference.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.url_app_banco: Link to your bank's app or mobile banking
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.url_app_banco_ayuda: Optional if your bank is not listed. Paste the app or mobile login URL.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.error_limite: Limit must be greater than zero.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.error_adeudado: Amount owed cannot exceed the limit.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_ayuda: Upload a statement photo or paste the text. TI tries to read cut-off, due date, balance, limit and digits. Always review before saving.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_usar: Use these values in the form
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_aplicado: Fields filled. Review them and complete bank/name if needed.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_fallo: Could not read the image. Paste the text manually and analyze again.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_sin_campos: Text was read, but no fields matched. Adjust the text or fill manually.

pantalla_lista_tarjetas.subtitulo: Tap a card to bring it to the front
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.subtitulo_abanico: Tap a card in the fan to bring it to the front
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_ventana_ciclo: Purchases after {inicio} and before {corte} count toward the cycle that closes on that cut-off. The band marks that period.
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_ventana_cerrado: You owe ${monto:,.2f} from the cycle that closed on {cierre}. Payment was due on {pago}. Red days mean delay and interest.
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_ventana_cerrado_pendiente: You owe ${monto:,.2f} from the cycle that closed on {cierre}. You have until {pago} to pay ({dias} days). You are still within the grace period.
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_compras_mas: +{n} more purchases in this period (see below)
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_compras_leyenda: purchases in this period (see Usage tab for details)
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_mensaje_tranquilo: Today is {hoy}. You have {dias} days until payment on {pago}. Cut-off is {corte} (in {dias_corte} days). You're in good shape.
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_mensaje_medio: Today is {hoy}. {dias} days left to pay on {pago}. Cut-off is {corte}. Start planning your payment.
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_mensaje_urgente: Today is {hoy}. Only {dias} days until payment on {pago}. Prioritize this payment to avoid interest.
pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_post_corte: Today is {hoy}. Cut-off on {corte} has passed. New purchases go on your next statement. Pay on {pago} — {dias} days left.

tabs.mejor_opcion_subtitulo: How much are you buying today? TI recommends the most comfortable card.
tabs.pagos_subtitulo: All cards sorted by urgency. Tap a card here or in the fan to see details.
tabs.pagos_subtitulo_tarjeta: Cycle debt, estimated interest and payment tracking for this card.
tabs.pagos_sin_deuda: No closed cycle debt pending payment on this card.
tabs.pagos_sin_deuda_con_acumulado: No prior cycle debt due now. You have ${monto:,.2f} accumulating in the current cycle (it will be part of your next statement).
tabs.pagos_urgente: Pay ${monto:,.2f} as soon as possible. Only {dias} days left to avoid interest.
tabs.pagos_atencion: Plan to pay ${monto:,.2f}. You have {dias} days left.
tabs.pagos_tranquilo: You owe ${monto:,.2f} from the current cycle. {dias} days until {pago}.
tabs.comprar_monto_invalido: Enter an amount greater than zero.
tabs.comprar_contra_sin_disponible: Not enough available: you have ${monto:,.2f} and the purchase is ${compra:,.2f}.
tabs.comprar_pro_dias_pago: You have {dias} days to pay — good margin.
tabs.comprar_contra_limite_alto: You would use {pct:.0f}% of your limit.
tabs.comprar_contra_limite_medio: You would approach {pct:.0f}% of your limit.
tabs.comprar_contra_umbral: This card is set to exclude from suggestions, but you decide.
tabs.comprar_contra_decision: The purchase exceeds your available credit. You can still register it, but check your limit.
tabs.comprar_resumen_abanico_ok: {nombre}: reasonable choice. You would have {dias} days to pay.
tabs.comprar_resumen_abanico_comoda: {nombre}: comfortable purchase — goes to next cycle ({dias} days to pay).
tabs.comprar_resumen_abanico_cuidado: {nombre}: you can use it, but plan your payment ({dias} days).
tabs.comprar_resumen_abanico_riesgo: {nombre}: this purchase does not fit your current available credit.
tabs.guia_subtitulo: Find extra bank charges — late fees, penalties and interest — in your banking app with a screenshot or pasted text.
tabs.umbral_subtitulo: Exclude this card from simulation when these limits are exceeded.
tabs.umbral_pct_recomendacion: Recommendation: Financial analysts suggest not exceeding 30% of your limit to keep healthy credit utilization.

config_tarjetas.subtitulo: Manage your cards, recommendation thresholds and cycle alerts.
config_tarjetas.umbral_abanico_nota: Thresholds apply to the card selected in the fan.
config_tarjetas.sin_tarjetas: You have no cards registered yet.

soporte.subtitulo: Version {version}. If something fails, generate a package and send it to TI's developer.
soporte.exportar_ayuda: Creates a ZIP with your cards and activity (your PIN is never included). Send it by WhatsApp or email so the case can be reviewed.
soporte.nota_placeholder: E.g. minimum payment on Gold does not lower the balance
soporte.export_ok: Package ready. Download and send it.
soporte.export_hint: Tap the button to download the ZIP, then send it by WhatsApp or email.

historial.vacio: No movements recorded for this card yet.

pantalla_recomendacion.sin_opcion: No card has enough available credit for this amount.
pantalla_recomendacion.dias_pago: You will have {dias} days before paying.
pantalla_recomendacion.sin_intereses: You won't accrue interest on this purchase.
pantalla_recomendacion.con_intereses: You may accrue interest if you don't pay on time.
pantalla_recomendacion.conclusion_comoda: This is the most comfortable option for your wallet.
pantalla_recomendacion.conclusion_cuidado: Use it carefully and plan your payment.
pantalla_recomendacion.conclusion_evitar: Consider postponing the purchase or using another card.
pantalla_recomendacion.compra_proximo_ciclo: This purchase goes on the next cycle and won't increase what you owe this month.
pantalla_recomendacion.sin_intereses_ciclo_actual: Your current cycle payment is not affected by this purchase.
pantalla_recomendacion.dias_pago_siguiente_ciclo: If you buy after cut-off, you would pay in {dias} days (next cycle).

intereses.aviso_tasa_estimada: To calculate interest and simulate payments we are using an estimated rate of {tasa:.0f}%. For the exact value we need your card's rate. You can find it on your statement or in your bank's app.
intereses.tasa_anual_ayuda: Ordinary annual rate for your card.
intereses.interes_diario_calc: Estimated daily interest: ${monto:.4f} (on ${saldo:,.2f} at {tasa:.2f}% annual, 360-day base)
intereses.pago_minimo_subtitulo: Default: 5% of debt or $200, whichever is greater. You can enter your bank's exact amount.
intereses.total_proximo_ayuda: Includes current cycle spending + carried balance + estimated interest ({dias} days).
intereses.sin_deuda_ciclo: No prior cycle debt. No interest from carryover.
intereses.barras_subtitulo: Green: full payment · Yellow: minimum · Red: carryover + interest
intereses.mensaje_pago_total: You won't pay interest and will start the next cycle clean.
intereses.mensaje_pago_minimo: It keeps you current, but the remaining balance will accrue interest and roll into the next cycle.
intereses.mensaje_no_pago: You will fall delinquent and the bank will apply a higher rate.
intereses.aviso_tasa_corta: We are using an estimated rate of {tasa:.0f}% because you have not yet recorded interest, late fees, or minimum payment rules. Go to the Guide tab to get this from {banco}.
intereses.desglose_subtitulo: How the accumulated total is formed
intereses.desglose_nota_minimo: If you pay only the minimum, these amounts roll into the next cycle.

banner_sugerencia.ciclo_pendiente_total: You owe {deuda} from the previous cycle with no new purchases. Your bank may already be charging interest on that balance. {dias} days left — paying the full {monto} is best.
banner_sugerencia.ciclo_pendiente_parcial: You owe {deuda} from the previous cycle. Recording {monto} today lowers frozen debt to {despues}, but interest may keep accruing until it's paid off.
banner_sugerencia.nota_interes_ya_genera: That balance is frozen cycle debt — not an optional top-up. Paying it off soon matters.
banner_sugerencia.ciclo_abierto_base: Your current cycle is open. Paying {monto} today would lower your statement snapshot from {antes} → {despues}.
banner_sugerencia.ciclo_abierto_historial: Your current cycle is open. Paying {monto} today would lower your statement snapshot from {antes} → {despues}.
banner_sugerencia.recomienda_historial: Based on your history, TI recommends paying {monto} to keep this card healthy.
banner_sugerencia.recomienda_pago_historial: Based on your history, a {monto} payment is typical for this card.
banner_sugerencia.aviso_no_banco: Record here what you already paid at your bank — Ideal Card does not transfer money.
banner_sugerencia.dialogo_cuerpo: Ideal Card does not transfer money — it only advises you. Open {banco}'s app to pay {monto}. When you're done, come back here to update your record.
banner_sugerencia.dialogo_sin_enlace: Search for your bank's app in your phone's app store.

asesor_diario.tranquilo: You're good today: nothing urgent due, and you have {disp} available to spend.
asesor_diario.ciclo_abierto: You have {monto} in purchases this cycle. Statement close: {corte}. Available: {disp}.
asesor_diario.pago_pendiente: You owe {monto} from last cycle. Due in {dias} days ({pago}). Paying soon helps avoid extra costs.
asesor_diario.pago_urgente: Important: you owe {monto} with only {dias} days left ({pago}). Paying on time protects your credit.
asesor_diario.datos_viejos: Heads up: you haven't updated this card in {dias} days — confirm your balance before a big purchase.
asesor_diario.chip_disponible: Available now on each card (based on what you recorded).

asesor_compra.disponible_ahora: Will your purchase fit? Check available credit before swiping.
asesor_compra.sin_disponible: {nombre} won't cover it: you have {disp} but the purchase is {monto}.
asesor_compra.proximo_ciclo: Use {nombre}: this purchase hits next cycle and you have {disp} free. Pay in ~{dias} days.
asesor_compra.comoda: Use {nombre}: you get {dias} days to pay with {disp} available.
asesor_compra.cuidado: You can use {nombre}, but only {dias} days to pay. Available: {disp}.

push.subtitulo: Enable alerts so TI reminds you about payments and key dates when you open the app (or in background on some browsers).
push.nota_movil: For alerts: allow permissions and add TI to your home screen.
push.instruccion_permiso: If your browser asks, choose Allow. On iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen, then enable alerts here.

pagos_estatus.aviso_no_banco: Remember: Ideal Card does not make payments or connect to your bank. Pay directly in your banking app or at your bank. Here we only update your information to keep your financial control up to date.
pagos_estatus.boton_total: I paid the full cycle amount
pagos_estatus.personalizado_label: Did you pay a different amount?
pagos_estatus.exito_total: Perfect. You paid in full and started a clean new cycle.
pagos_estatus.exito_minimo: Minimum payment registered. You stay current, but the remaining balance will move to the next cycle.
pagos_estatus.exito_personalizado: Payment registered. We updated your balance and availability.

uso.ciclo_pasado_mensaje: Amount closed at cut-off. It no longer grows with new purchases.
uso.ciclo_nuevo_mensaje: Grows with each purchase. It will be part of the next cycle.
uso.disponible_mensaje: What you can still use from your limit.
uso.sin_compras_ciclo_nuevo: No purchases registered in this cycle yet.
uso.costo_no_pagar_titulo: Cost of not paying on time
uso.costo_no_pagar_subtitulo: What it costs you to leave the previous cycle open
uso.mensaje_costo_no_pagar: This amount no longer grows with purchases: it grows over time. Every day you wait, paying costs more.
uso.desglose_nuevo_subtitulo: Breakdown of what you've accumulated since cut-off
uso.mensaje_ciclo_nuevo: This amount keeps growing with your purchases. It will be part of the next cycle.
uso.ciclo_pasado_dentro_plazo: Frozen balance ${saldo:,.2f}. You still have {dias} days until {pago} to pay without interest. ( ? ) shows what happens if you miss the due date.

reportes.subtitulo: View, compare, sort and print your cards' status
reportes.sin_tarjetas: Add at least one card to generate reports.
reportes.sin_resultados: No cards match the selected filters.
reportes.salud_para_que: A quick on-screen read: what you owe, how urgent it is, and what happens if you only pay the minimum. It is not the main view to print.
reportes.salud_nota_impresion: To print, use By card (one card detail) or By priority (all cards sorted by urgency).
reportes.salud_resumen_urgente: {n} card(s) need attention soon — read each message below.
reportes.salud_msg_libre: You're in good shape: no previous-cycle debt and no new purchases this cycle.
reportes.salud_msg_solo_acumulando: Nothing due from the previous cycle yet. You have ${monto:,.2f} building toward the {corte} statement close.
reportes.salud_msg_urgente: You owe ${monto:,.2f} with only {dias} days left (due {pago}). Prioritize this card to avoid interest.
reportes.salud_msg_atencion: You owe ${monto:,.2f}. {dias} days until {pago} — start planning your payment.
reportes.salud_msg_tranquilo: You owe ${monto:,.2f} from the previous cycle. {dias} days until {pago}; you're in good shape.
reportes.salud_msg_con_interes: You owe ${monto:,.2f} before {pago} ({dias} days). Estimated interest if you don't pay in full: ~${interes:,.2f}.
reportes.salud_dato_interes: Est. interest ${monto:,.2f} if not paid in full
reportes.salud_dato_si_minimo: If you only pay the minimum, next cycle could reach ~${monto:,.2f}

notificaciones.subtitulo: TI Financial Advisor shows one banner above the tabs, only on the matching day and only for the card selected in the fan.
notificaciones.despues_pago: Notify each day after due date (interest)
notificaciones.despues_corte: Notify day after close if previous cycle is still unpaid
notificaciones.inicio_ciclo: Notify when a new cycle starts (no pending debt)
notificaciones.nota_un_dia: Each alert appears only on its matching day. The same event won't repeat until the next cycle.

ayuda_bancos.guia_titulo: How to find your document at {banco}
ayuda_bancos.secciones_probables: Look for these sections (names may vary by app version):
ayuda_bancos.instruccion_captura: When you find the fees or charges screen: take a screenshot, upload it or paste the text, then tap Analyze.
ayuda_bancos.interpretacion_cargos: These are **extra charges** from your bank (late fees, penalties or period interest). Worth checking in your banking app.
ayuda_bancos.interpretacion_mora: I detected a **penalty rate** — usually applied when payment is late.
ayuda_bancos.interpretacion_tasas: These are the **reference rates** for your card from the screenshot.
ayuda_bancos.aplicar_opcional_nota: Only if you want Usage and Payments to use these rates. Extra charges are for reference.
ayuda_bancos.texto_manual: Or paste the text you see on screen
ayuda_bancos.texto_manual_placeholder: E.g. Purchase APR 24.99% · Late Fee up to $39
ayuda_bancos.ocr_no_disponible: OCR is not installed on this device. Paste the text manually and TI will parse it.
ayuda_bancos.sin_datos: No rates or fees detected. Make sure the text is readable or paste it manually.
ayuda_bancos.nota_solo_informativo: Shown for reference only; not saved to the card yet.
ayuda_bancos.resumen_info: TI read your screenshot and extracted the most important information.
ayuda_bancos.seleccionar_tarjeta: Which card should receive this information?
ayuda_bancos.sin_tarjetas: Register at least one card to apply rates.
ayuda_bancos.nada_que_aplicar: Select at least one rate to apply.
